summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, attaching a monthly return submitted to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The filing reports no movements in authorized or issued share capital, no changes in treasury shares, and confirms compliance with public float requirements. No share options, warrants, or convertibles were exercised. This is a routine regulatory filing with no special-situation corporate action, such as acquisitions, divestitures, or capital returns, and does not indicate any event warranting classification under any special-situations category.
